name: Anomaly Detection In IoT Sensor Data
model: Dynamic Threshold Isolation Forest + Exponential Moving Z-Score
description: IoT time-series anomaly detection system establishing baseline operating envelopes and raising alerts on sensor drift or spikes.
limitations: Seasonal thermal cycles can trigger false positive alerts if static thresholds are used instead of dynamic baselines.
responsible_use_notes: Facilitates real-time industrial monitoring and equipment safety protection.
